candidate.answerReason: Sampling is appropriate for destructive investigations or very large populations. Exact agreement with population characteristics is not guaranteed, and surveying all three prizewinners is practical.

methods.label: Choose the suitable survey type
methods.explanation: Sampling is suitable for destructive investigations or very large populations. Sample results are estimates and are not guaranteed to exactly match the true characteristics of the population. A census is appropriate for learning about all 3 prizewinners because there are very few subjects. Therefore, the correct choice is C.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 distinctions between censuses and sample surveys and their suitable applications.
